# Driatheli Group SRL - Infinitrade Romania

> Supplier and distributor of industrial equipment in Romania since 2009.
> Pumps, valves, electric motors, heat exchangers, blowers.
> Brands: Grundfos, Wilo, Siemens, ABB, Alfa Laval, KSB, ARI Armaturen, Spirax Sarco.

Sitemap: https://www.infinitrade.ro/sitemap.xml

- [Mechanical Components & Transmissions](https://infinitrade.ro/componente-mecanice) - SKF, FAG, NSK, Timken, Gates. Bearings, belts, chains, seals, couplings
- [Filters & Industrial Consumables](https://infinitrade.ro/filtre-consumabile) - Mann+Hummel, Donaldson, Parker, Hydac. Hydraulic, air, oil filters
- [Tools & Measuring Instruments](https://infinitrade.ro/scule-instrumente) - Bosch Professional, Hilti, Makita, Mitutoyo. Power tools, pneumatic tools, precision measuring
- [Thermal & HVAC Equipment](https://infinitrade.ro/echipamente-termice) - Carrier, Daikin, Trane, Grundfos HVAC. Chillers, boilers, fan heaters, AC systems
- [Lubricants & Industrial Chemicals](https://infinitrade.ro/lubrifianti-chimice) - Shell, Mobil, Castrol, Klüber. Hydraulic oils, greases, adhesives, coolants
- [Auxiliary Equipment & Safety](https://infinitrade.ro/echipamente-auxiliare) - 3M Safety, Dräger, MSA, Kärcher Industrial. PPE, industrial cleaning, dosing systems, tanks

## Industry Solutions
We serve 15 industries:
- [Petrochemicals & Refineries](https://infinitrade.ro/industrii/petrochimie) - ATEX certified equipment for refineries and cracking units
- [Food Industry](https://infinitrade.ro/industrii/alimentar) - Stainless steel 316L equipment, EHEDG/3A certified, food-safe
- [Water Treatment](https://infinitrade.ro/industrii/tratare-apa) - Drinking water and wastewater treatment plant equipment
- [Energy & Utilities](https://infinitrade.ro/industrii/energie) - Power plants and district heating equipment
- [Pharmaceutical](https://infinitrade.ro/industrii/farmaceutic) - Clean room compatible equipment
- [Chemical Industry](https://infinitrade.ro/industrii/chimie) - Chemical-resistant materials for aggressive media
- [Mining & Extraction](https://infinitrade.ro/industrii/minerit) - Slurry pumps and mine dewatering equipment for abrasive conditions
- [Construction & HVAC](https://infinitrade.ro/industrii/constructii) - Circulation pumps, balancing valves and pumping groups for commercial buildings
- [Automotive Industry](https://infinitrade.ro/industrii/automotive) - Hydraulic press systems, production-line bearings and automation for car plants
- [Metallurgy & Steel](https://infinitrade.ro/industrii/metalurgie) - Equipment rated for extreme-temperature environments near furnaces
- [Cement Industry](https://infinitrade.ro/industrii/ciment) - Dust filters, transmission belts and blowers for clinker mills
- [Paper & Pulp Industry](https://infinitrade.ro/industrii/hartie) - Pulp pumps, consistency sensors and heat exchangers for paper mills
- [Logistics & Warehousing](https://infinitrade.ro/industrii/logistica) - Conveyor motors, sorting pneumatics and sensors for distribution centers
- [Biogas & Green Energy](https://infinitrade.ro/industrii/biogaz) - Biomass pumps, pH/level sensors and aeration blowers for biogas plants
- [Shipbuilding & Maritime](https://infinitrade.ro/industrii/naval) - Marine pumps, deck hydraulics and bronze valves resistant to seawater corrosion

## How to Request a Quote
Use the form at [infinitrade.ro/contact](https://infinitrade.ro/contact) (name, email, phone, company, category of interest, message).
To get an accurate quote faster, include in your message:
- Product/model code or brand, if known
- Nameplate data (flow, pressure, power, voltage, or other relevant technical specs)
- Quantity needed
- Process conditions (fluid/medium, temperature, environment, application)
- Desired delivery timeframe
Response time: within 1 business day.
